God's humble remnant, the son who changed his mind, sinners who believed.

sub: The proud city listened to no voice.
God leaves a humble remnant.
They take refuge in his name.
q: For I will leave in the midst of you a people humble and lowly. They shall seek refuge in the name of the LORD.
For the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is his name.
points.apply: Let someone else have the credit today.

sub: One son said no, then went.
The other said yes and did not go.
God wants deeds, not just words.
q: The Lord said: Because these people draw near with their mouths and honor me with their lips, while their hearts are far from me, and their worship of me is a human commandment learned by rote.
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father in heaven.
points.apply: Turn one “no” to God into a “yes” today.

sub: Tax collectors and prostitutes believed John.
The leaders saw and did not repent.
It is never too late to turn.
q: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted, and saves the crushed in spirit.

For John came to you in the way of righteousness and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him; and even after you saw it, you did not change your minds and believe him.
points.apply: Go to Confession before Christmas.

concl: God builds with the humble.
Let your yes become action.
2026-12-15.resolve: Finish one good work you started and abandoned.

intro: Theme: “Are you the one?”
Heaven rains down the Saviour; John asks from prison; Jesus answers with signs.

sub: Rorate caeli: the Advent chant.
Grace comes down; earth brings forth.
God alone saves.
q: Shower, O heavens, from above, and let the skies rain down righteousness; let the earth open, that salvation may spring up, and let it cause righteousness to sprout up also; I the LORD have created it.
And the Word became flesh and lived among us, and we have seen his glory, the glory as of a father's only son, full of grace and truth.
points.apply: Sing or pray the Rorate caeli this week.

sub: John asks from prison.
Even prophets struggle.
Honest questions are prayer.
q: Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.
When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptist has sent us to you to ask, ‘Are you the one who is to come, or are we to wait for another?’”
points.apply: Bring an honest doubt to Jesus.

sub: The blind see, the lame walk.
The poor hear good news.
Blessed is the one not offended.
q: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

And he answered them, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, the poor have good news brought to them. And blessed is anyone who takes no offense at me.”
points.apply: Do one work of mercy as a sign of Christ.

concl: Christ answers our questions with his works.
Let us become his signs.
2026-12-16.resolve: Visit the poor or sick before Christmas.

intro: Theme: “O Wisdom, come!”
The O Antiphons begin; God keeps his promise to Judah; Jesus enters a real family tree.

sub: Wisdom orders all things.
Christ is the Wisdom of God.
Come and teach us prudence.
q: She reaches mightily from one end of the earth to the other, and she orders all things well.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
points.apply: Pray today's O Antiphon morning and evening.

sub: Jacob blesses Judah.
The promise runs through David.
It is fulfilled in Jesus.
q: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until tribute comes to him; and the obedience of the peoples is his.
An account of the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
points.apply: Thank God for a promise he kept in your life.

sub: Saints and sinners, kings and nobodies.
Four women, some foreigners.
Jesus enters our history.
q: I will bless those who bless you, and the one who curses you I will curse; and in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed.

And Jacob the father of Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called the Messiah. So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David to the deportation to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the deportation to Babylon to the Messiah, fourteen generations.
points.apply: Pray for your ancestors by name.

concl: God writes salvation through real families.
O Wisdom, come and teach us!
2026-12-17.resolve: Pray one O Antiphon each day until 23 December.

intro: Theme: “God with us.”
The righteous Branch, Joseph's obedient faith, and the name of Jesus.

sub: Jeremiah's promise to David's house.
A King who deals wisely and justly.
His name: The Lord is our righteousness.
q: The days are surely coming, says the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land. In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. And this is the name by which he will be called: “The LORD is our righteousness.”

Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife, for the child conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit. She will bear a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.
points.apply: Pray for just leaders in our country.

sub: The virgin conceives.
God is with us.
Christmas is God's nearness.
q: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Look, the young woman is with child and shall bear a son, and shall name him Immanuel.
“Look, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall name him Emmanuel,” which means, “God is with us.”
points.apply: Pray “Emmanuel, be with us” at each meal today.

sub: He was just and merciful.
He changed his plans.
He acted without a word.
q: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.
When Joseph awoke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him; he took her as his wife.
points.apply: Do at once one thing God asks of you.

concl: God is with us in Jesus.
Like Joseph, let us listen and obey.
2026-12-18.resolve: Pray to St Joseph daily until Christmas.

intro: Theme: “Your prayer has been heard.”
God turns barrenness into life, consecrates from the womb, and turns silence into song.

sub: Manoah's wife was barren.
Elizabeth was barren and old.
God gives life where none seemed possible.
q: And the angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, “Although you are barren, having borne no children, you shall conceive and bear a son.”
But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will name him John.”
points.apply: Pray for couples longing for children.

sub: Samson, a nazirite from birth.
John, filled with the Spirit before birth.
Every life belongs to God from conception.
q: For you shall conceive and bear a son. No razor is to come on his head, for the boy shall be a nazirite to God from birth. It is he who shall begin to deliver Israel from the hand of the Philistines.
For he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He must never drink wine or strong drink; even before his birth he will be filled with the Holy Spirit.
points.apply: Pray for the protection of unborn life.

sub: Zechariah doubted.
His silence became waiting.
It will burst into praise.
q: For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O LORD, from my youth. Upon you I have leaned from my birth; it was you who took me from my mother's womb. My praise is continually of you.
This is what the Lord has done for me when he looked favorably on me and took away the disgrace I have endured among my people.
points.apply: Keep fifteen minutes of silence today.

concl: God hears long prayers.
In silence we prepare our song for Christmas.
2026-12-19.resolve: Make a silent half-hour before the crib on Christmas Eve.

intro: Theme: “Blessed is she who believed.”
The Beloved comes; Mary hastens; the unborn John leaps for joy.

sub: The bride hears his voice.
He comes over mountains and hills.
God hurries toward us.
q: The voice of my beloved! Look, he comes, leaping upon the mountains, bounding over the hills.
In those days Mary set out and went with haste to a Judean town in the hill country.
points.apply: Visit someone who is lonely before Christmas.

sub: The unborn child recognises his Lord.
Elizabeth is filled with the Spirit.
Every life is precious from the womb.
q: Listen to me, O coastlands, pay attention, you peoples from far away! The LORD called me before I was born, while I was in my mother's womb he named me.

When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the child leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit and exclaimed with a loud cry, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.”
points.apply: Pray for unborn children and their mothers.

sub: Abraham believed and was reckoned righteous.
Mary believed the angel's word.
Faith is the root of Mary's greatness.
q: And he believed the LORD; and the LORD reckoned it to him as righteousness.

And why has this happened to me, that the mother of my Lord comes to me? For as soon as I heard the sound of your greeting, the child in my womb leaped for joy. And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.
points.apply: Renew your trust in one promise of God.

concl: Faith hurries to serve.
Christ comes, and the little ones leap for joy.
2026-12-21.resolve: Make one visit of charity before Christmas.

intro: Theme: “My soul magnifies the Lord.”
Hannah's gift, Mary's song, and the great reversal of God's Kingdom.

sub: She prayed for a child.
God answered.
She gave the child back to God.
q: For this child I prayed; and the LORD has granted me the petition that I made to him. Therefore I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he lives, he is given to the LORD.
For the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is his name. His mercy is for those who fear him from generation to generation.
points.apply: Offer back to God one gift he has given you.

sub: The proud are scattered.
The lowly are lifted up.
The hungry are filled.
q: The LORD makes poor and makes rich; he brings low, he also exalts. He raises up the poor from the dust; he lifts the needy from the ash heap, to make them sit with princes and inherit a seat of honor.

He has shown strength with his arm; he has scattered the proud in the thoughts of their hearts. He has brought down the powerful from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly; he has filled the hungry with good things, and sent the rich away empty.
points.apply: Help a poor family prepare for Christmas.

sub: God promised Abraham a blessing for all.
Mary sees it fulfilled.
God remembers his mercy.
q: I will bless those who bless you, and the one who curses you I will curse; and in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed.
He has helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy, according to the promise he made to our ancestors, to Abraham and to his descendants forever.
points.apply: Thank God for a promise kept in your family.

concl: God's power is shown in mercy to the humble.
Let our souls magnify the Lord.
2026-12-22.resolve: Pray the Magnificat every evening until Christmas.

intro: Theme: “His name is John.”
The messenger is born; the Lord comes as refiner's fire; silence breaks into praise.

sub: Malachi promised a messenger.
Jesus says John is that messenger.
He prepares the way of the Lord.
q: See, I am sending my messenger to prepare the way before me, and the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple. The messenger of the covenant in whom you delight—indeed, he is coming, says the LORD of hosts.
This is the one about whom it is written, ‘See, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.’
points.apply: Prepare one practical thing for Christmas with prayer.

sub: Who can endure his coming?
He purifies like a refiner.
Christ baptises with Spirit and fire.
q: But who can endure the day of his coming, and who can stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner's fire and like fullers' soap; he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the descendants of Levi and refine them like gold and silver, until they present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
I baptize you with water for repentance, but one who is more powerful than I is coming after me; I am not worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
points.apply: Make your Christmas Confession today or tomorrow.

sub: The family wanted “Zechariah”.
God had chosen “John”.
Obedience frees Zechariah's tongue.
q: Listen to me, O coastlands, pay attention, you peoples from far away! The LORD called me before I was born, while I was in my mother's womb he named me.
He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And all of them were amazed. Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began to speak, praising God.
points.apply: Praise God aloud for one mercy today.

concl: God names, calls and frees.
O Emmanuel, come!
2026-12-23.resolve: Be reconciled with someone before Christmas Eve.

intro: Theme: “The dawn from on high.”
Zechariah's Benedictus: God keeps his promise, John prepares the way, and the dawn breaks tonight.

sub: God promised David an heir.
Zechariah sees the promise fulfilled.
God visits and redeems his people.
q: When your days are fulfilled and you lie down with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring after you, who shall come forth from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, for he has looked favorably on his people and redeemed them. He has raised up a mighty savior for us in the house of his servant David.
points.apply: Pray the Benedictus this morning.

sub: John goes before the Lord.
He gives knowledge of salvation.
Forgiveness of sins prepares the heart.
q: A voice cries out: “In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.”
And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the Lord to prepare his ways, to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the forgiveness of their sins.
points.apply: Forgive someone before Christmas night.

sub: People in darkness see a great light.
The Sun of justice rises.
He guides our feet into peace.
q: But for you who revere my name the sun of righteousness shall rise, with healing in its wings. You shall go out leaping like calves from the stall.
By the tender mercy of our God, the dawn from on high will break upon us, to give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
points.apply: Make one act of peace in your family today.

concl: Advent ends in praise.
The dawn is breaking: Christ is near.
2026-12-24.resolve: Attend Christmas Mass with your whole family.

intro: Theme: “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.”
Stephen, deacon and first martyr, dies like his Master, forgiving.

sub: A deacon who served the poor.
He preached with the Spirit's wisdom.
Christ speaks through his witnesses.
q: Now go, and I will be with your mouth and teach you what you are to speak.

When they hand you over, do not worry about how you are to speak or what you are to say; for what you are to say will be given to you at that time; for it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
points.apply: Serve the poor during the Christmas octave.

sub: Stephen looks up.
He sees Jesus standing.
The martyr's eyes are fixed on Christ.
q: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, faithful God.

But filled with the Holy Spirit, he gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God. “Look,” he said, “I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
points.apply: Pray “Into your hands I commend my spirit” tonight.

sub: The Servant intercedes for transgressors.
Stephen prays like Jesus while Saul watches.
Forgiveness is never wasted.
q: Therefore I will allot him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he poured out himself to death, and was numbered with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.” Then he knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he died.
points.apply: Pray by name for someone who hurt you.

concl: The crib leads to the Cross, and the Cross to glory.
Forgive as Stephen forgave.
2026-12-26.resolve: Reconcile with someone during the Christmas octave.

intro: Theme: “Rachel weeping for her children.”
Joseph obeys, the Innocents die for Christ, and God gathers the little ones to himself.

sub: The angel speaks in a dream.
Joseph leaves at night.
The Son relives Israel's journey to Egypt.
q: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

Now after they had left, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and remain there until I tell you; for Herod is about to search for the child, to destroy him.”
points.apply: Obey promptly when God's will is clear.

sub: Herod fears for his throne.
The children of Bethlehem are killed.
God hears the cry of mothers.
q: Thus says the LORD: A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping. Rachel is weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.

When Herod saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, he was infuriated, and he sent and killed all the children in and around Bethlehem who were two years old or under, according to the time that he had learned from the wise men.
points.apply: Comfort a family that has lost a child.

points.h: The little ones belong to Christ
sub: The Innocents confessed Christ by dying.
God rescues his own from the snare.
Every child is precious.
q: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped. Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
but Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of heaven belongs.”
points.apply: Pray and work for unborn and endangered children.

concl: Herod's darkness does not have the last word.
Holy Innocents, pray for all children.
2026-12-28.resolve: Support a work that protects children this week.

intro: Theme: “My eyes have seen your salvation.”
Simeon, led by the Spirit, welcomes the light of the nations and foretells the sword.

points.h: The Lord comes to his temple
sub: Malachi promised it.
Simeon waits in the Spirit.
The Child is carried into the Temple.
q: See, I am sending my messenger to prepare the way before me, and the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple. The messenger of the covenant in whom you delight—indeed, he is coming, says the LORD of hosts.

Guided by the Spirit, Simeon came into the temple; and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him what was customary under the law, Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying,
points.apply: Visit the Blessed Sacrament this week.

sub: The Servant is given as a light.
Salvation for all peoples.
No one is excluded.
q: he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the survivors of Israel; I will give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth.”

Master, now you are dismissing your servant in peace, according to your word; for my eyes have seen your salvation, which you have prepared in the presence of all peoples, a light for revelation to the Gentiles and for glory to your people Israel.
points.apply: Pray for those who do not yet know Christ.

points.h: God carries us to the end
sub: Simeon is old and ready.
He foretells the sword.
God carries his people through sorrow.
q: even to your old age I am he, even when you turn gray I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save.

Then Simeon blessed them and said to his mother Mary, “This child is destined for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be opposed so that the inner thoughts of many will be revealed—and a sword will pierce your own soul too.”
points.apply: Visit an elderly person this week.

concl: The waiting of Israel is fulfilled in Simeon's arms.
Let us walk in the light.
2026-12-29.resolve: Pray the Nunc Dimittis each night this week.

intro: Theme: “She spoke about the child.”
Anna's faithful prayer, her joyful witness, and the quiet growth of Jesus at Nazareth.

sub: A widow for many years.
Fasting and prayer night and day.
God carries the old.
q: even to your old age I am he, even when you turn gray I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save.

There was also a prophet, Anna the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was of a great age, having lived with her husband seven years after her marriage, then as a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped there with fasting and prayer night and day.
points.apply: Pray for the elderly in your parish.

sub: The Spirit is poured on all.
Anna prophesies.
Every believer is a witness.
q: Then afterward I will pour out my spirit on all flesh; your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, and your young men shall see visions.
At that moment she came, and began to praise God and to speak about the child to all who were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.
points.apply: Speak to one person about Jesus this week.

sub: The family returns home.
The child grows in wisdom.
Faith is taught from childhood.
q: Train children in the right way, and when old, they will not stray.

When they had finished everything required by the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth. The child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom; and the favor of God was upon him.
points.apply: Teach a child a prayer this week.

concl: A life of prayer leads to joyful witness.
The world passes; God's will remains.
2026-12-30.resolve: Thank an elderly person who taught you the faith.

intro: Theme: “Grace upon grace.”
At the end of the year: the eternal Word, the light that darkness cannot overcome, and thanksgiving for every grace.

sub: God created all things by his word.
The Word was with God and was God.
Christ is Lord of every year.
q: In the beginning when God created the heavens and the earth, the earth was a formless void and darkness covered the face of the deep, while a wind from God swept over the face of the waters. Then God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light.

In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. He was in the beginning with God. All things came into being through him, and without him not one thing came into being.
points.apply: Offer the coming year to Christ.

sub: The glory of the Lord has risen.
Christ is the light of the world.
Whoever follows him does not walk in darkness.
q: Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen upon you.
Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness but will have the light of life.”
points.apply: Bring one darkness of this year to Confession.

sub: Teach us to count our days.
Count the graces received.
Begin the new year with thanksgiving.
q: So teach us to count our days that we may gain a wise heart.
From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace. The law indeed was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
points.apply: Take part in the Te Deum tonight.

concl: Time belongs to Christ.
We end the year with thanks and begin it with Mary.
2026-12-31.resolve: Begin the new year at Mass on the Solemnity of Mary, Mother of God.
